prose: Oxide Computer Company, which sells on-premise integrated cloud computer systems, raised a $445 million Series D led by Eclipse at a $6 billion valuation, taking its total funding to roughly $835 million.

highlights: Oxide Computer raises a $445M Series D led by Eclipse
Valued at $6B; total funding now about $835M
